final: WITH award_players AS (SELECT DISTINCT pa.player_id, COALESCE(p.bats, '(blank)') as batting_hand FROM player_award pa JOIN player p ON pa.player_id = p.player_id), hand_stats AS (SELECT batting_hand, COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) as player_count FROM award_players GROUP BY batting_hand), totals AS (SELECT SUM(player_count) as total_count FROM hand_stats), with_shares AS (SELECT hs.batting_hand, hs.player_count, CAST(hs.player_count AS REAL) / t.total_count as share FROM hand_stats hs CROSS JOIN totals t), avg_calc AS (SELECT SUM(share) / CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) as avg_share FROM with_shares) SELECT ws.batting_hand, ws.player_count, ws.share, ws.share - ac.avg_share as above_average FROM with_shares ws CROSS JOIN avg_calc ac WHERE ws.share > ac.avg_share ORDER BY ws.share DESC
